name: Mezőnyárád (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part and a yellow lower fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mezőnyárád: a crowned light blue shield with a white dove holding an olive branch above a ploughshare on a green base.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
